person_note: The base narration is third person. The authorized opening sustains an external narrator, and separated interior and late-book passages preserve that structure while moving among characters and rendering Jennifer's interiority. Goodreads event quotes q02474 and q02480 corroborate this third-person limited/omniscient pattern. All visible narratorial-looking I/we material in the remaining quotes is speech, direct thought, gnomic text, or paratext rather than an autonomous first-person section. No epistolary, framed, or alternating-person structure was found. The main limitation is the absence of an explicit whole-book POV declaration, but the authorized opening, widely separated interior evidence, and diagnostic quote evidence agree without credible contradiction.
